:::{#exm-evaluation-bracket}
#### Evaluating $\int_1^3 2t\,dt$ with a bracket

$F(t) = t^2$ is an antiderivative of $f(t) = 2t$, since $\deriv{t} t^2 = 2t$, so

$$
\ba
\int_1^3 2t\,dt
&= \sb{t^2}_{t=1}^{t=3}
&& \text{(FTC Part 2)}
\\
&= 3^2 - 1^2
&& \text{(definition of the evaluation bracket)}
\\
&= 9 - 1
&& \text{(square)}
\\
&= 8
&& \text{(subtract)}
\ea
$$

:::
